name: Disify API
description:
REST API for disposable email detection, email validation, and MX record checking.
Core checks work anonymously; API keys add account limits and plan features.
Per-minute limits count HTTP requests. Daily/monthly quotas count validation
inputs, with duplicates removed within each bulk request. Repeated requests count again.
Check HTTP status before interpreting validation fields. A successful check
does not prove mailbox ownership or guarantee delivery.
This specification covers the primary routes; legacy path suffixes for
bulk input, premium features, and downloads are described in the documentation.
